H54.reason: DESI public documentation states that underlying DR2 spectra/redshifts are not yet released; an official DESI Data Q&A states that DR2 correlation functions and covariances will be publicly released with the full DR2 release. Public BAO cosmology chains/posterior maximization products exist, but this does not establish executable custody of the new Ly-alpha full-shape AP+BAO covariance/likelihood required by H54.
not_established_public_custody: authoritative executable joint AP+BAO likelihood package for H54
H54.resolution_condition: Authoritative public release or directly citable supplementary product provides the exact correlation/covariance/likelihood inputs needed for a non-double-counted AP+BAO reproduction, followed by local hashing and official-reference replay.
H54.falsifier_policy: Website or paper discovery alone cannot close H54; availability != materialization != reference reproduction != RLL validation.

sources.observed: Underlying spectra and redshifts for DR2 have not yet been released; BAO cosmology chains and posterior maximization files are public.
Official DESI response states correlation functions and covariances will be publicly released alongside the full DR2 release.
